m.description: array_like, shape (..., M, N) Input array.

k.description: int, optional Diagonal above which to zero elements. `k = 0` (the default) is the main diagonal, `k < 0` is below it and `k > 0` is above.

output.description: ------- ndarray, shape (..., M, N) Lower triangle of `m`, of same shape and data-type as `m`.
